# HEIC fixture

`example.heic` is the upstream libheif example, downloaded 2026-11-14 from:
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/master/examples/example.heic

Primary image: 1280 x 854. Used for production-browser and packaged Electron
import, PNG export, drag/paste, missing MIME and offline regression checks.
This fixture is not included in the application distribution.
